seed: Nonempty Unicode string,1-256 UTF-8 bytes,strict encoding,no normalization,case/whitespace preserved;no integer/coerced seeds.
stream: SHA256(ASCII FutureCards +00+ ASCII v1 +00+ ASCII domain +00+ uint32be(seed_byte_length)+seed_utf8+uint64be(counter));counter starts0,eight uint32be words per digest,consumed in order.
randbelow: For n in1..2^32,limit=2^32-(2^32 mod n);discard uint32 words>=limit;return word mod n. Never a biased direct-modulo fallback.
celtic: Remove significator before shuffle. Three rounds of full Fisher-Yates then nonempty cut k=1+randbelow(N-1);top segment moves to bottom. One/three-card use one shuffle,no cut.
orientation: Independent orientation stream,one randbelow(2) per drawn card:0 upright,1 reversed. Upright-only consumes no orientation words;deck stream unchanged. Significator upright;crosswise visual rotation of position2 is not a reversal.
assurance: Reproducible application convention,not a cryptographic security guarantee,physical shuffling model,historical PRNG or predictive probability.
replay: Record exact seed,protocol/profile,canonical IDs/hash,filtered deck,round count,cuts,full shuffled pack and drawn orientations.
